topic: How my M&E agent reads a workbook without relying on tab names
prompt: Make one precise correction to this finished opaque square data graphic: REMOVE the small author name/byline from the bottom-right corner completely, replacing it with the same continuous warm ivory background. Do not add any replacement name, logo, initials, text or watermark there. Keep ALL other words, letters, headline, subtitle, header labels, three data rows, classification labels, footer "Header rules. Visible limits.", layout, typography and colors exactly as they are. Preserve the completely opaque full-canvas ivory background. No transparency. Correct nothing else.
original_brief: Create a polished square editorial data graphic titled "Read the columns." with the subtitle "How my M&E agent classifies a sheet". Show three crisp rows of illustrative headers and their actual classification: "Indicator / Target / Actual" maps to "KPI TRACKER"; "Risk / Likelihood / Impact" maps to "RISK REGISTER"; "Unmatched headers" maps to "UNKNOWN". Use generous typography, precise aligned table rows, an ink navy and warm cream palette with restrained citrus accents. Label the examples "Illustrative headers". Footer: "Header rules. Visible limits." No sketches, model drawings, wireframes, fake screenshots, generic people, invented statistics, decorative charts, stock icons, repeated legacy flowchart composition or internal instructions.
